chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: G major with a wistful borrowed minor chord
warm singing pulse-wave lead whose phrases rise then sigh down a step
rolling plucked harp arpeggios of broken major triads like sunlight rippling on water
slow round synth bass moving root to fifth
very soft brushed kick and faint hi-hat like water lapping
nostalgic, sun-warmed, bittersweet remembered-summer ruin theme
seamless transition back to the theme
